admin_risk_severity.instructions: Rate residual admin/configuration privilege risk after operator-only adminUserKeys edits and transactional audit, if cloud still uses old defaults or an empty admin list
criteria: none: no meaningful privilege path remains; empty admin list is safe and recoverable only via trusted operator
low: operational inconvenience only; no unauthorized admin mutation path
medium: deploy misconfiguration could lock out ops or leave unintended admin keys if process is skipped
high: a realistic production path lets untrusted actors gain admin or grant membership or credits
critical: ordinary consumer users can currently become admin or alter membership or quota at will
